_about: Labelled requests for checking how a router picks skills (embedding match, a trained classifier, anything). `expect` is a skill name, or null when no skill should apply. Re-measure after any description change: on 2026-11-14 (before the third-person rewrite) the right skill ranked first for 16 of 16 positives. Scores of right matches (0.42-0.58) overlap those of non-matches (up to 0.46), so an absolute threshold cannot separate them; compare routers by top-1 accuracy and by false positives on the null cases.
